summary: My two cents—True Blood was created during the golden era of television & is one of my absolute faves of all time. So many solid characters—Lafayette, Pam, Eric, Jason, Jessica, Arlene, Andy—the list continues. Yes, the last couple of seasons are weaker than the first few however it is still a banger of a show.
